l1_capabilities.name: Contract Legal Services
l1_capabilities.description: Legal services within contract lifecycle management across all BCI business units, including drafting, review, and recommendations. Legal's contribution to enterprise-wide Contract Management (Procurement owns vendor contracts, asset classes own investment contracts, HR owns employment contracts)

l2_capabilities.name: Investment Transaction Legal Guidance & Due Diligence
l2_capabilities.description: Legal due diligence, transaction structuring, and legal guidance for BCI's investment transactions, including fund investments, co-investments, and portfolio company transactions

l2_capabilities.name: Investment Management Agreements Management
l2_capabilities.description: Drafting, negotiating, reviewing, and managing legal agreements with regards to investment and fund management.

l2_capabilities.name: Fund Documentation & Structuring
l2_capabilities.description: Legal guidance for fund formation / documentation, subscription agreements, and investment / fund structure optimization

l2_capabilities.name: Co-Investment & Joint Venture Legal Services
l2_capabilities.description: Legal guidance on structuring and documentation for co-investment opportunities and joint venture arrangements with other investors or partners

l2_capabilities.name: Securities & Investment Regulatory Compliance
l2_capabilities.description: Ensuring compliance with securities regulations, investment restrictions, regulatory requirements specific to investment activities (e.g., prospectus requirements, securities filings, investment limits)

l1_capabilities.name: Corporate Governance
l1_capabilities.description: Management of corporate governance, board operations, policy administration, and corporate records management.

l2_capabilities.name: Contract Review
l2_capabilities.description: Legal review of contracts initiated by business units (procurement, HR, IT), including risk assessment, legal terms negotiation, and approval workflows

l2_capabilities.name: Contract Drafting & Template Management
l2_capabilities.description: Drafting BCI led contracts (NDAs, settlement agreements, legal service agreements) and maintaining contract templates, clause libraries, and contract standards

l1_capabilities.name: Government Relations
l1_capabilities.description: Management of BCI's relationships with government entities, regulatory stakeholders, and freedom of information requests

l2_capabilities.name: Litigation Management
l2_capabilities.description: Management of litigation matters including court proceedings, discovery, legal strategy, outside counsel coordination, legal holds, settlements, and court filings

l2_capabilities.name: General Matter Management
l2_capabilities.description: Intake, tracking, assignment, collaboration, and closure of non-litigation legal matters across all practice areas (investment, advisory, compliance, transactional), including matter workflow management and resource allocation

l1_capabilities.name: Legal Regulatory & Compliance
l1_capabilities.description: Enterprise-wide regulatory compliance and ethics program management, including regulatory intelligence, privacy compliance, trading controls, and ethics programs. Legal owns this at BCI.

l2_capabilities.name: External Counsel & Vendor Management
l2_capabilities.description: Selection, engagement, management, and oversight of external law firms and legal service providers (e.g. legal research vendors, legal technology vendors), including outside counsel guidelines and e-billing

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Financial Management
l2_capabilities.description: Legal Affairs department budgeting, forecasting, spend tracking, variance analysis, invoice processing, and financial reporting to manage Legal Affairs' financial resources effectively. Note: Enterprise budgeting owned by Finance; this is Legal's departmental budget

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Technology Management
l2_capabilities.description: Management of Legal Affairs' technology stack (e.g. matter management, law firm e-billing, document management, research databases), vendor relationships, technology implementation, user adoption, system optimization, first line technical support and technology strategy.

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Knowledge Management
l2_capabilities.description: Management of Legal's knowledge assets including knowledge repository, precedent libraries, playbooks, templates, best practices, and expertise directories to capture and share legal knowledge

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Performance Management
l2_capabilities.description: Legal operations analytics, dashboards, KPIs, metrics, performance reporting, and business intelligence to measure Legal Affairs' effectiveness, efficiency, and value delivery

l2_capabilities.name: Entity Management
l2_capabilities.description: Compliance requirement; entity records current but process is manual.

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Training and Development
l2_capabilities.description: Professional development of Legal Affairs staff including continuing legal education (CLE), skills development, training programs, career development, and succession planning for Legal Affairs team members. Note: This develops Legal staff (distinct from Stakeholder Legal Education which trains business)

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Affairs Project Management
l2_capabilities.description: Manage legal-related projects, ensuring compliance, timely delivery, and alignment with organizational objectives through structured planning, resource management, and risk oversight.

l1_capabilities.name: Investment Legal Services
l1_capabilities.description: Legal services supporting BCI's investment activities, including fund investments, investment manager relationships, and securities compliance specific to investment operations

l2_capabilities.name: Regulatory Intelligence & Change Management
l2_capabilities.description: Monitoring regulatory changes, horizon scanning, regulatory interpretation, impact analysis, and maintaining regulatory content repository to keep Legal and business informed of regulatory developments

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Compliance Program Design & Advisory
l2_capabilities.description: Development and management of compliance programs, compliance assessments, compliance monitoring and testing, regulatory reporting and filings, and compliance advisory to business units

l2_capabilities.name: Personal, Private, and Sensitive Information Protection Legal Advisory
l2_capabilities.description: Privacy compliance (e.g. PIPEDA, GDPR), privacy impact assessments, privacy policy development, personal, private, and sensitive information protection advisory, privacy breach response and notification, and consent management

l2_capabilities.name: Trading & MNPI Controls
l2_capabilities.description: Personal trading preclearance, trade monitoring, material non-public information (MNPI) management, and restricted list management

l2_capabilities.name: Ethics & Code of Conduct Management
l2_capabilities.description: Code of Conduct administration, ethics programs, misconduct case management (intake, investigation, resolution), whistleblower hotline management, and ethics training.

l1_capabilities.name: Legal Advisory & Research
l1_capabilities.description: Legal advisory, research, and education services provided to BCI business units, supporting business decision-making, risk assessment, and legal awareness

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Research & Analysis
l2_capabilities.description: Legal research using legal databases (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Practical Law), precedent analysis, statutory interpretation, case law research, and legal intelligence gathering

l2_capabilities.name: Legal Opinion & Guidance
l2_capabilities.description: Providing legal opinions, and guidance to business stakeholders on legal questions, typically delivered through memos or emails

l2_capabilities.name: Corporate Transaction Guidance & Due Diligence
l2_capabilities.description: Legal guidance for BCI corporate transactions (M&A involving BCI itself, corporate partnerships, strategic alliances) and due diligence. Note: Distinct from Investment Transaction guidance (which covers BCI's investment activities)

l2_capabilities.name: Risk Assessment & Advisory
l2_capabilities.description: Legal risk identification, assessment, and advisory to support business decision-making, including legal risk scoring, risk mitigation recommendations, and decision support

l2_capabilities.name: Stakeholder Legal Education & Training
l2_capabilities.description: Training and educating business stakeholders on legal topics, compliance requirements, policy changes, legal developments, and legal literacy to enable proactive risk management. Note: This is Legal training THE BUSINESS (distinct from Legal Talent Development which trains Legal staff)

l1_capabilities.name: Legal Operations & Administration
l1_capabilities.description: Operational capabilities that enable Legal Affairs to function effectively, including external counsel management, budget, technology, knowledge, performance, and project management

l2_capabilities.name: Corporate Governance Guidance
l2_capabilities.description: Managing corporate governance framework, governance policies, corporate governance best practices, and governance advisory to ensure BCI meets governance standards and obligations

l2_capabilities.name: Board & Committee Guidance
l2_capabilities.description: Managing board and committee meetings, preparing board materials, maintaining board minutes and resolutions, managing board approvals, and coordinating board-related legal activities

l2_capabilities.name: Policy & Directive Management
l2_capabilities.description: Development, maintenance, review, and retirement of corporate policies and directives, including policy approval workflows, policy communication, and policy repository management

l2_capabilities.name: Records Management
l2_capabilities.description: Management of BCI's records management definitions and practices, including record classifications and retention schedules, and archiving to ensure compliance with records retention regulations and obligations.

l1_capabilities.name: Matter & Case Management
l1_capabilities.description: Management of legal matters, cases, and legal work across Legal Affairs, including litigation, disputes, and general legal matters, tracked through matter management systems

l2_capabilities.name: Government Relations Strategy & Engagement
l2_capabilities.description: Development and execution of government relations strategies, engagement with government entities and regulatory stakeholders, advocacy, issues management, and managing BCI's government affairs activities

l2_capabilities.name: Freedom of Information (FOI) Management
l2_capabilities.description: Complete FOI request lifecycle management including FOI intake, assessment, response coordination, disclosure review, FOI tracking, deadline management, and FOI compliance to meet access to information obligations
